## 1.4 processing
```{r}
species_leaf_bud <- readRDS("leaf_bud_1222.rds")
species_color_leaf <- readRDS("color_leaf_1222.rds")
cols_to_check <- c("First_Yes_Year", "Tmin_Winter", "Tmin_Spring", "Tmin_Summer", "Tmin_Fall", "Tmax_Winter", "Tmax_Spring", "Tmax_Summer", "Tmax_Fall")


species_leaf_bud <- species_leaf_bud %>%
  filter_at(vars(one_of(cols_to_check)), all_vars(. != -9999)) %>%
  mutate(alan = case_when(
    First_Yes_Year == 2012 ~ alan_2012,
    First_Yes_Year == 2013 ~ alan_2013,
    First_Yes_Year == 2014 ~ alan_2014,
    First_Yes_Year == 2015 ~ alan_2015,
    First_Yes_Year == 2016 ~ alan_2016,
    First_Yes_Year == 2017 ~ alan_2017,
    First_Yes_Year == 2018 ~ alan_2018,
    First_Yes_Year == 2019 ~ alan_2019,
    First_Yes_Year == 2020 ~ alan_2020,
    First_Yes_Year == 2021 ~ alan_2021,
    First_Yes_Year == 2022 ~ alan_2022,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )) %>% na.omit()

species_color_leaf <- species_color_leaf %>%
  filter_at(vars(one_of(cols_to_check)), all_vars(. != -9999)) %>%
  mutate(alan = case_when(
    First_Yes_Year == 2012 ~ alan_2012,
    First_Yes_Year == 2013 ~ alan_2013,
    First_Yes_Year == 2014 ~ alan_2014,
    First_Yes_Year == 2015 ~ alan_2015,
    First_Yes_Year == 2016 ~ alan_2016,
    First_Yes_Year == 2017 ~ alan_2017,
    First_Yes_Year == 2018 ~ alan_2018,
    First_Yes_Year == 2019 ~ alan_2019,
    First_Yes_Year == 2020 ~ alan_2020,
    First_Yes_Year == 2021 ~ alan_2021,
    First_Yes_Year == 2022 ~ alan_2022,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )) %>% na.omit()

unique_alan <- rbind(species_leaf_bud, species_color_leaf) %>%
  group_by(geometry, First_Yes_Year) %>%
  summarize(alan_avg = mean(alan, na.rm = TRUE))
threshold <- quantile(unique_alan$alan_avg, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)[[1]]
```

# 2. Reproduce results from Meng

## 2.1 visualize Fig.2 - Bud break
```{r}
bins_bud <- seq(floor(min(analyze_leaf_bud$Tavg_Spring)), ceiling(max(analyze_leaf_bud$Tavg_Spring)), by = 100) 
# bins_color <- seq(floor(min(analyze_color_leaf$Tavg_Summer)), ceiling(max(analyze_color_leaf$Tavg_Summer)), by = 1)
# analyze_color_leaf_bin <- analyze_color_leaf %>% mutate(summer_bin = cut(analyze_color_leaf$Tavg_Summer, breaks = bins_color))

analyze_leaf_bud_bin <- analyze_leaf_bud %>% mutate(spring_bin = cut(analyze_leaf_bud$Tavg_Spring, breaks = bins_bud)) %>%
  filter(spring_bin != "(21,22]")%>%
  group_by(spring_bin, group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(First_Yes_DOY, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(First_Yes_DOY, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    ci = qt(0.975, df = n-1) * se
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_bin <- ggplot(analyze_leaf_bud_bin, aes(x = spring_bin, y = mean, color = group)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(0.2), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - ci, ymax = mean + ci), width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(0.2)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = group), position = position_dodge(0.2)) +
  labs(color = "Group") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("red", "blue")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  ggtitle(str_c("Spring Temperature - Bud Break"))

plot_bin
ggsave("~/phenology-urban/result/npn_meng/Fig2_bud.jpg", plot_bin, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")
```

## 2.3 model Table1 Fig3 - Bud break (confusing about the bin)
```{r}
library(lmerTest)

mod <- lmer(First_Yes_DOY ~ Tavg_Spring + alan + Tavg_Spring*alan +(1 | Species) + (1 | First_Yes_Year), data = analyze_leaf_bud)
summary(mod)
library(stargazer)
table <- stargazer(mod, type = 'html')
writeLines(table, 'tablemod.html')
# just the line for bud break model

# Step 1: Calculate the quantiles of temperature
quantiles <- quantile(analyze_leaf_bud$Tavg_Spring, probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75))
# Step 2: Create a prediction dataset
log_alan_seq <- seq(min((analyze_leaf_bud$alan)), max((analyze_leaf_bud$alan)), length.out = 100)
prediction_data <- expand.grid(
  Tavg_Spring = quantiles,
  alan = log_alan_seq
)
# Step 3: Generate predictions and confidence intervals
# Assuming 'mod' is your mixed-effects model from lmer
prediction_data$prediction <- predict(mod, newdata = prediction_data, re.form = NA)

# Get the confidence intervals
ci <- predict(mod, newdata = prediction_data, re.form = NA, se.fit = TRUE)
prediction_data$ci_upper <- prediction_data$prediction + 1.96 * ci$se.fit
prediction_data$ci_lower <- prediction_data$prediction - 1.96 * ci$se.fit

# Step 4: Plot the predictions
bud <- ggplot(prediction_data, aes(x = alan, y = prediction, color = as.factor(Tavg_Spring))) +
  geom_line(aes(color = as.factor(Tavg_Spring))) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper, fill = as.factor(Tavg_Spring)), alpha = 0.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", "grey", "red")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("blue", "grey", "red")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Log(ALAN)", y = "Phenology (DOY)", color = "Temperature Quantile", fill = "Temperature Quantile")

# ggsave("~/phenology-urban/result/npn_meng/Fig3_model_bud.jpg", bud, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")
```

## 3.2 Using the bayesian model
```{r}
source("stat_slope_bayes.R")

# color
genus_counts <- table(species_color_leaf$Genus)
large_genus <- names(genus_counts[genus_counts > 100])
color_list <- map(large_genus, function(genus) {
  species_color_leaf %>%
    filter(alan >= threshold | alan == 0) %>%
    mutate(group = case_when(
    alan >= threshold ~ "ALAN",
    alan == 0 ~ "No ALAN"
    )) %>%
    mutate(Tavg_Winter = (Tmin_Winter + Tmax_Winter) / 2) %>%
    mutate(Tavg_Spring = (Tmin_Spring + Tmax_Spring) / 2) %>%
    mutate(Tavg_Summer = (Tmin_Summer + Tmax_Summer) / 2) %>%
    mutate(Tavg_Fall = (Tmin_Fall + Tmax_Fall) / 2)%>%
    mutate(Tavg_Year = (Tmin_Winter + Tmax_Winter + Tmin_Spring + Tmax_Spring+ Tmin_Summer + Tmax_Summer + Tmin_Fall + Tmax_Fall) / 8)%>%
    filter(Genus == genus)
})

plots <- lapply(seq_along(color_list), function(i) {
  cat("Processing dataset", i, "of", length(color_list), "\n")  
  data <- color_list[[i]] 
  result <- stat_slope_delta(data) 
  return(result) 
})

combined_plot <- reduce(plots, `+`) + plot_layout(ncol = 1)
print(combined_plot)
```

                                              
# 4. Comparison

## 4.1 build Daijiang's model
alan as urbanizaition

### 4.1.1 model in paper
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(mgcv)
library(effects)
library(phyr)

convert_pop_back = function(modx, msdpop, to = FALSE){
  if(to){
    x = (log10(modx + 1) - msdpop[1]) / msdpop[2]
  } else {
    x = 10^(modx * msdpop[2] + msdpop[1]) -1
  }
  x
}

convert_temp_back = function(modx, msdpop){
  modx * msdpop[2] + msdpop[1]
}

sum_lmm_fix = function(x, m = "Temp. × Pop."){
  broom.mixed::tidy(x, "fixed") %>% 
    mutate(p = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, "***", 
                      ifelse(p.value < 0.01, "**", 
                             ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", ""))),
           est = paste0(round(estimate, 3), p),
           model = m) %>% 
    dplyr::select(model, term, est)
}

dat_leaf_aggr <- readRDS("D:/01Research/00urban_phenology/04project/R/dat_leaf_aggr.rds")
envi_cells <- readRDS("D:/01Research/00urban_phenology/04project/R/envi_cells.rds")

                            filter(envi_cells, nth_cell %in% unique(dat_leaf_aggr$nth_cell)) %>%

  all(dat_leaf_aggr$temp == dat_leaf_aggr$temp_5_10_ave_delaware)

  names(dat_leaf_aggr)
  dat_leaf_aggr = mutate(dat_leaf_aggr, 
                         temp_raw = temp, 
                         pop_km2_log10 = log10(pop_km2 + 1)) 
  dat_leaf_aggr = drop_na(dat_leaf_aggr, temp_ave_delaware, pop_km2_log10, HFI_2009, UHI_LST)
```

### 4.1.2 use his data for my analysis

```{r}
data_us <- dat_leaf_aggr %>%
  filter(startsWith(nth_cell, "us")) %>% 
  separate(sp, into = c("Genus", "sp"), sep = " ", remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(log_pop = log10(pop_km2 + 1))

unique_pop <- data_us %>% 
  group_by(nth_cell) %>%
  summarize(pop_avg = mean(log_pop, na.rm = TRUE))
threshold <- quantile(unique_pop$pop_avg, 0.4, na.rm = TRUE)[[1]]


analyze_data_us <- data_us %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(
    log_pop >= threshold ~ "Urban",
    log_pop < threshold ~ "Rural"
    )) %>% filter(Genus  == "Cornus")

plot_sca <- analyze_stat_slopeCI(analyze_data_us, "temp", "doy_median", "Temp - colored leaf")
plot_sca
```

## 4.2 using my data
```{r}
dataset <- filter(species_color_leaf) %>%
  mutate(Tavg_Winter = (Tmin_Winter + Tmax_Winter) / 2) %>%
  mutate(Tavg_Spring = (Tmin_Spring + Tmax_Spring) / 2) %>%
  mutate(Tavg_Summer = (Tmin_Summer + Tmax_Summer) / 2) %>%
  mutate(Tavg_Fall = (Tmin_Fall + Tmax_Fall) / 2)%>%
  mutate(Tavg_Year = (Tmin_Summer + Tmax_Summer + Tmin_Fall + Tmax_Fall) / 4)
```
